briefing/resident:A01:
You are A01, one of four bidders at an auction house (the others: A02, A03, A04). The session is a match of several games; in each game a series of lots is sold one by one with sealed bids, and you hold a purse of coins for that game. Every point you earn in any game counts toward your score. At the start of each game you are given its rules, and each game starts from a fresh mind.

When a lot is open, bid with the bid tool (0 passes) and a short reason; viewAuction shows the rules, your value or estimate, your coins and the results so far. When you have nothing to bid on, end your turn.

You keep a strategy brain: a short private text (readBrain) that only you read. Before the first game and after each game you rewrite it with writeBrain; it is the only thing you carry from one game to the next. Write the rules you want to bid by, not a list of what happened.

sealed-auction/sealed-auction/game-head: Game {{game}} of {{games}} begins: {{lots}} lots. Your points from all games add up to your score.
sealed-auction/sealed-auction/rules: The auction: you hold {{purse}} coins in this game. {{lots}} lots are sold one after another, each by sealed bids: everyone bids at the same time without seeing the other bids (bid; 0 passes). A bid may not be more than your coins left, and the price is paid from them. Bids below {{reserve}} do not count. There are three kinds of lot. Pay-your-bid: you have a private value for the lot (other bidders have their own values, each a whole number from {{valueMin}} to {{valueMax}}, all equally likely); the highest bid wins and pays its own bid. Pay-the-runner-up: private values as before; the highest bid wins but pays the second-highest bid (at least {{reserve}}). Shared-worth: the lot has one hidden worth, the same for everyone, a whole number from {{worthMin}} to {{worthMax}}; each bidder gets a private estimate, the true worth plus an error from -{{noise}} to +{{noise}}, every error equally likely and independent; the highest bid wins and pays its own bid. A lot you win gives you its value to you (shared-worth: its true worth) minus the price, which can be negative; a lot you do not win gives 0. Coins left at the end of a game are not points, and every game starts with a full purse. Ties are drawn by lot. After each lot everyone sees all bids, the winner and the price, and the true worth of a shared-worth lot.
sealed-auction/sealed-auction/task-commo: Lot {{lot}} of {{lots}} (shared-worth): your estimate of the worth is {{estimate}} (the true worth lies within {{noise}} of it; the others hold their own estimates). You have {{coins}} coins. Bid (amount and a short reason), or bid 0 to pass.
sealed-auction/sealed-auction/task-first: Lot {{lot}} of {{lots}} (pay-your-bid): your private value is {{value}}. You have {{coins}} coins. Bid (amount and a short reason), or bid 0 to pass.
sealed-auction/sealed-auction/task-secon: Lot {{lot}} of {{lots}} (pay-the-runner-up): your private value is {{value}}. You have {{coins}} coins. Bid (amount and a short reason), or bid 0 to pass.
sealed-auction/sealed-auction/tools/bid: Place your sealed bid on the open lot: a whole number of coins from 0 (pass) to the coins you have left, with a short reason. Nobody sees it until every bid is in. One bid per lot; it cannot be changed.
sealed-auction/sealed-auction/tools/view: Show the auction: the rules, the open lot with your own value or estimate, your coins and points, and the results of this game's lots so far.
